artifact.input: x: float32[N, 1, T] — raw 16 kHz mono waveform; processed in 160000-sample (10 s) windows
artifact.output: y: float32[N, num_frames, 7] — per-frame powerset logits over 3 local speakers, max 2 concurrent

notes: Speaker-segmentation model for turn splitting in the diarization stage, run via ort. Powerset output is argmax-decoded to per-frame local-speaker activity, then turns are embedded (src/diarize/embedding.rs) and clustered by the online registry for session-stable global identity. Bundled (include_bytes!) so diarization works fully offline.
